"PREMIER PLAY" has had no $3 million top prize claimed since we started watching it. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

The second-biggest prize left on "PREMIER PLAY" is $100,000, with four of them remaining.

Everything here about "PREMIER PLAY" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 23.
2414.headline: Top prizes have lasted so far

2415.body:
"Double The Money" has 178,367 prizes of $10 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $2,000 prize, with two left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Tomorrow's count on "Double The Money" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2415.headline: A close look at the prizes

2416.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Loaded with $2,000s", about a third are still unsold. The game is past the halfway point of its run, with 1,128 of 3,372 top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

The numbers for "Loaded with $2,000s" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2416.headline: How far along this game is

2419.body:
About three-quarters of the tickets for "Bronze 7s" have been sold. The game is well into its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

The numbers for "Bronze 7s" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2419.headline: How much has sold

2420.body:
"Silver 7s" has gone over a month without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About half of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $177,777 prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

The numbers for "Silver 7s" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2420.headline: Top prizes are still left

2421.body:
"Gold 7s" has 184,026 prizes of $10 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $7,000 prize, with eight left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

If "Gold 7s" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2421.headline: A close look at the prizes

2422.body:
The prize money on "Platinum 7s" leans no one direction in particular. It is spread over eleven prize levels, from wins equal to the ticket price up to $2 million. Games built like this fund both the small prizes and the large ones. That design never changes, and it is the part you choose.

The numbers for "Platinum 7s" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2422.headline: The prize mix in this game

2426.body:

Everything here about "HAUNTED HUNDREDS" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 23.

One of MERRY MONEY TREE's top prizes was claimed last week. A player in Virginia won $125,000. The game started with four top prizes and now has three top prizes. Nothing bigger can change on a scratcher.
